description: The Microtek Luxe WiFi 1400 Inverter with Lithium Battery Combo is a smart and modern power backup solution designed for homes, offices, and shops. Equipped with a Pure Sine Wave 1100VA inverter, it ensures smooth, safe, and uninterrupted power for sensitive electronic devices and daily household appliances. This combo includes a high-performance 12.8V 100Ah Lithium-ion Battery (MLB1280060) that offers faster charging, deeper discharge capability, longer life cycles, and higher efficiency compared to traditional lead-acid batteries. The lithium battery is lightweight, compact, and completely maintenance-free, making it a perfect fit for contemporary living spaces. With WiFi-enabled smart monitoring, users can easily track system performance and battery status through a mobile application, adding convenience and better power management. The system is ideal for running lights, fans, LED TV, Wi-Fi router, laptops, and other essential loads during power outages. Backed by 36 months warranty on the inverter and 60 months warranty on the lithium battery, the Microtek Luxe WiFi 1400 combo delivers dependable performance, advanced technology, and long-lasting power backup in one compact solution.
